title: Cost breakdown modal — interaction redlines and stakeholder synthesis
creator: Asha Menon
description: We need a focused interaction pass for the Cost Breakdown modal that surfaces per-route and per-model cost drivers (tokens, batching efficiency, cached hits) and improves discoverability of rollout-related cost leak indicators. This ticket consolidates stakeholder feedback from two design walkthroughs and one cross-functional review and documents redlines, accessibility fixes, and QA items for the engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Updated Figma screens with redlines applied (desktop and narrow desktop) uploaded to the design handoff board
Interaction spec (keyboard flows, focus states) captured in the modal's page notes
A11y contrast and aria-label changes documented and validated by design QA
Design decisions and open questions reviewed and acknowledged by PM and ENG leads
A PR-ready assets zip with SVG icons (optimized), motion specs (Lottie/JSON), and micro-copy variants added to attachments
comments: 2026-02-26 — PM review (Sofia Iqbal): Align on the surface priority. PM suggests surfacing 'cache hit rate' as a primary pillar for cost attribution. Marked as important for enterprise customers.

2026-03-01 — Eng review (Carlos M): Raised performance concern about rendering the per-request sparkline for large result sets. Suggest server-side sampling and lazy-loading charts. Assigned ENG-5198 for implementation plan.

2026-03-03 — Accessibility review (Priya Rao): Color contrast for the secondary tokens label fails AA at narrow widths. Recommend swapping to 700 weight and updating token badge background. Shared a test case in Axe.

2026-03-04 — Design walk (internal stakeholders): Two alternatives presented for the 'rollout leak' callout (inline warning vs. sticky banner). Consensus to use an inline, dismissible warning adjacent to the metric row with the option to 'View rollout details'.
2026-03-06 — Visual polish pass (design): Tightened spacing between token badge and model name; updated microcopy for header to remove ambiguity around 'Estimated cost' vs 'Billed cost'.

2026-03-08 — QA checklist (Samir Chen): Listed cross-browser quirks for the modal overlay z-index on older Chromium versions; noted need for focus trap verification and keyboard only dismissal behavior.
2026-03-09 — PM sign-off (Sofia Iqbal): Approved copy and prioritization of cache hit metric. Asked that initial rollout of this modal target console-2026.03 with a canary for Dedicated customers.

2026-03-10 — Hand-off (Liam Ortega): Uploaded final redlines and noted two open engineering questions: 1) sampling frequency for sparkline heatmap, 2) fallbacks for no-cache data. See dependencies ENG-5198.
decisions: Show cache hit rate as a first-class column in the breakdown and use an info tooltip to explain calculation
Use server-side sampling for long history sparklines; client will lazy-load detailed charts on demand
Inline, dismissible 'rollout leak' warning displayed next to affected route; clicking 'View rollout details' opens the Rollouts panel
Accessibility fixes: increase contrast on token labels, add aria-describedby linking metric rows to tooltip IDs, and ensure modal focus trap with ESC to close
open_questions: What is the threshold for marking a route as a 'rollout leak' (absolute delta vs percentage)? Suggested: 15% token cost increase over baseline — PM to confirm.
For customers on Dedicated, should we enable live sparkline streaming or keep to sampled snapshots to avoid telemetry costs? (ENG to propose cost/latency trade-off)
Do we need localization variants for the microcopy in the warning state? (i18n team input requested)
qa_notes: Verify focus order for all interactive elements inside the modal (tabbing sequence) — include keyboard-only test
Confirm that the inline 'rollout leak' banner is reachable by screen reader and labelled correctly
Cross-browser test: z-index and backdrop blur behavior on Chromium 95 and Firefox 101
Asset validation: SVG icons should be optimized (<= 4KB where possible) and exported with correct viewBox
next_steps: PM to confirm rollout leak threshold and update the ticket (target: 2026-03-12)
ENG (owner ENG-5198) to provide sampling strategy and estimate (target: 2026-03-15)
Design to apply any final copy tweaks and generate PR-ready assets zip (Liam) — attach to this ticket
Schedule a short handoff sync with ENG and PM after sampling approach is defined
notes_for_engineering: Implement focus trap and ESC to close behavior; ensure backdrop is non-interactive
Expose an API for the console backend to return sampled sparkline points and cache-hit percentage
Provide a feature flag for the inline rollout warning so it can be canaried to Dedicated customers
Use reduced-motion preference for sparkline animations
